    LauncherSaver
    Utility for saving user-created application launchers as .lgcfg descriptor files.
    SwingAppLauncher
    Runs a conventional Swing application's main inside the lg3d desktop JVM so that every top-level window it creates is seen by the global SwingNodeWindowCapture hook and integrated into the 3D desktop - its JFrames become real desktop windows and its JOptionPane / JFileChooser / popup dialogs render in-scene - with NO changes to the application.
